_doc: PB-187 break-cap, end-to-end. Fixture: break_min=30, session=90, a FIXED workout anchor at 16:15 (2h padded slot). After the 13:15 lunch, one 90-min block (13:15-14:45) + a capped 30-min break (14:45-15:15) leaves a 60-min residual before the 16:15 anchor. The fixed rules (PB-187) say: cap the break at break_min and BANK the residual as work — so 15:15-16:15 is 'Block 5 - focus work', NOT an inflated 60-min break. The driver runs the REAL plan-my-day.sh (asserts the emitted session carries the break-cap + residual-as-work rules), writes the real dated plan file with these rows, then asserts: every break row <= 30, the row ending at 16:15 is a focus-work block, and the day tiles gap-free. tracking_kind=vault-file -> the report shows the real Today-at-a-glance table.
